items.difficulty_reason: After named Stanley–Reisner/Gorenstein foundations and the first fundamental theorem of invariant theory, the derivative identity still requires full authored Plucker second-derivative cancellation, absolute invariant control, the unique square monomial criterion, and nonzero coefficient induction in dimension. The complete Brion/cone/simplex reductions and derivative pairing/power descent are retained, so anisotropy on the Gorenstein quotient barH is a consequence within the same required core, not a second count. One exact characteristic-two generic-field unit is selected, with no characteristic-zero or Hard Lefschetz helper outcome; conservative H2 remains subject to root admission.
